result:
If I could choose one change, I’d make a safe, loved childhood universal.

Not a perfect childhood, or one designed to produce a particular kind of person. Just one where food, shelter, affection, and safety aren’t things you have to earn—and where you have room to discover who you want to be.

It wouldn’t solve everything. But fewer people would spend their lives recovering from the beginning of them.
